query:
SELECT EXISTS(
               SELECT 1 FROM issues i
               WHERE i.id = $1
                 AND (i.reporter_id = $2
                      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM group_members g1
                                 JOIN group_members g2 ON g2.group_id = g1.group_id
                                 WHERE g1.user_id = $2 AND g2.user_id = i.reporter_id))
           ) as "visible!"
